verdict: A near-identical rebuild of the Wikipedia Community home whose worst gaps are a too-round featured image card and 1-3 px drifts in the card text and nav labels; well-named auto-layout structure, but repeated nav items and styles are not reused.

top_defects.where: featured article image card, top corners
top_defects.what: corner radius about 24 dp (about 62 px) where the reference shows about 16 dp (about 40 px); the heatmap lights up both top corners

top_defects.where: article extract in the summary card and the bottom navigation labels
top_defects.what: extract lines start 2-3 px higher with a slightly tighter line pitch; the nav labels (Saved, Search, Activity, More) render a little heavier and about 1 px lower than the reference; with the date line and other 1-2 px vertical offsets this costs 2 layout points too
the five nav items are separate frames, not instances of one component; there are no text or color styles (styled: 0), only the Tab and bookmark icon are components
the image, scrim, action buttons and summary are positioned absolutely inside a 380x414 'Card' frame (28 absolute layers), so the summary does not reflow against the image

strengths: Every text, icon, badge dot and color of the reference is present and correct, including the EN language button, the red 'new' dots and the #e8f0ff Home pill
The real app icons and the Wikipedia wordmark are kept as vectors, and the article photo is a real image fill with the 39 % veil
Clear named hierarchy (Header, Tab bar, Community banner, Section header, Featured article card, Bottom navigation) with auto-layout on bars, lists and rows
